title: Setting of the hearing
text:
19.39.010 Setting of the hearing.
When the responsible official determines that an application is complete and that a public hearing is required by this title, the official shall schedule a public hearing with the city plan commission, select a place and a time certain for the hearing, and shall cause notice of such hearing to be prepared and made in accordance with this article. The time set for the hearing shall conform to the time periods required by this article.
(Ord. 16882 § 2 (part), 2008)
